meta.tileEncoding: like stars.json milkyWay: uint8 log scale, 0 = empty; count = exp(ln(countMin) + (v-1)/254*(ln(countMax)-ln(countMin))); stars per deg2 = count / sampleFraction / step^2 (cells are step x step in l and b; multiply area by cos b for true solid angle)
meta.tileIndexing: byte bi*width + li; l = l0 + (li+0.5)*step, l wrapped to [-180,180); b = b0 + (bi+0.5)*step
meta.tileSource: Gaia DR3 gaia_source via ESA Gaia Archive TAP; only cells inside the ICRS circle of radiusDeg are filled, the rest are 0 (no data, not empty sky)
meta.bpRpEncoding: uint8; 0 = none; mean BP-RP = v/255*3 mag
meta.namesSource: IAU Catalog of Star Names (IAU-CSN), IAU WGSN, compiled by E. Mamajek; CC BY; V <= 6.5
